newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline up $9 on trades, U.S. sentiment.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline up $9 on trades, U.S. sentiment.

text.p: NWE gasoline spiked up again on Thursday with barges showing $9.00 a tonne gains.
Dealers said eurograde Rotterdam barges traded at $227 and $229 amid buoyant U.S. futures which have been boosted by a shut down at Exxon's Baytown 190,000 bpd cat cracker.
The rise in U.S. prices has encouraged traders to take material from Europe transatlantic and tankers have been fixed.
The European market looks tight in the Med and far from overflowing in NWE, but some dealers feel the $9.00 price hike was overdone.
